newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 9.00-9.25 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 9.00-9.25 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar eased in a narrow 9.00-9.25 pct range on Wednesday with higher supply of dinars in the market, dealers said.
Bankers and dealers said the bulk of deals were conducted at 9.00 percent against a 9.25-9.50 percent range on Tuesday.
A tight market has persisted since last week with continued substantial fund transfers by state ministries to the Central Bank that have kept the market short, dealers said.
